articles.description: TORONTO - Former Toronto Blue Jays player Rich Butler and his wife are facing fraud charges in connection with a youth baseball training program, Durham Regional Police said Tuesday.
articles.title: Former Blue Jays player Rich Butler, wife, charged with fraud in Ontario

articles.description: Richard Butler, a Toronto-born outfielder signed by the Jays in 1990 is accused of taking funds from a Ontario Devil Rays baseball training program that never delivered on the services it promised.
articles.title: Former Blue Jays player, wife accused of defrauding families $60,000 in youth baseball program
